label: Autocosmos

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Autocosmos API v3 (OpenAPI) for AR/CL/CO/EC/MX/PE: dealer publications, branches, leads, catalog taxonomy; keys by emailing developers@autocosmos.com; no public listings search.

reason: Autocosmos API v3 (https://api.autocosmos.com.ar/DocsV3, HMAC AppKey/AppSecret by email to developers@autocosmos.com) manages a dealer's own publications, branches, leads and the catalogue taxonomy; its branch listing is the account's own, not a dealer directory, and there is no public listing search or valuation. The automotive vocabulary is read-only, so it is recorded, not served.
